item.title: Jury seated in Youngstown murder retrial
item.description: Danyo Sellers of Youngstown, also known as Legend Pless, is on trial before Judge Anthony D'Apolito on charges of murder and involuntary manslaughter for the April 15, 2023, shooting death of Amya Monseratt, who was shot and killed in the parking lot of a Southern Boulevard restaurant following a birthday party.

item.title: State burn ban back in effect
item.description: In addition to the statewide regulation, local governments may have additional rules established, so it's a good idea to check the ordinances where you live before doing any burning.

item.title: Will attacks in Iran affect gas prices?
item.description: Gas prices have been steady in Northeast Ohio this past week, but the recent attacks on Iran could make those numbers climb.

item.title: EPA: Analysts altered measurements in East Palestine train derailment sampling
item.description: The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) sent notice to a company for what the EPA classified as a failure to maintain data quality standards in groundwater sampling conducted at the East Palestine train derailment site.

item.title: Man awaits sentencing for abusing corpse in Brookfield
item.description: Francis Brennick, 57, pleaded guilty last month to the fifth-degree felony, and a presentencing investigation was ordered. Brennick had also faced a failure to register charge, with court records indicating that he was a registered sex offender in Massachusetts.

item.title: McDonald tops Badger to advance to district title game
item.description: McDonald boys basketball tops Badger 83-59 in the OHSAA Division VII District Semifinal to advance to the district title game.

item.title: Shepas leaving Warren Harding, will return to coaching
item.description: He has served as athletic director with WCS since July of 2024.

item.title: YPD: Pizza delivery driver robbed late Sunday on South Side
item.description: Officers met the driver about 11:10 p.m. in the 2700 block of Glenwood Avenue, and the driver then led police to a home on West Indianola Avenue, reports said.

item.title: Man arrested in Sharon during 'Predator Poachers' sting: Police
item.description: The Sharon Police Department issued a media release on Monday confirming the arrest of Calvin Kendall, 47. Police arrested Kendall in the 600 block of Frank St. on Sunday night.

item.title: Report: Valley native joins staff of major college football program
item.description: He spent the last 13 seasons as the head coach at the University of Kentucky.
